description: Series query-encoding and response-parse vectors. `query` cases map series parameters to the EXACT set of query-string parameters the SDK must send: every key listed in `query` must be present with that string value, and every key NOT listed must be absent (this is how `gapfill` omitted-when-false and optional `tz`/`mode` passthrough are pinned). `from`/`to` are given as already-formatted RFC-3339 strings so the mapping is language-agnostic; each SDK additionally formats native date/time inputs to this same shape, tested per-SDK. `bucket` is assumed already validated (see buckets.json). `parse` cases map a SeriesResponse body to the parsed points; the wire keys `t` (bucket start, RFC-3339) and `v` (delta, arbitrary-precision decimal string) are preserved verbatim by every SDK.

query.name: minimal
query.note: Only from/to/bucket set; no tz, no mode, gapfill defaulted false ⇒ exactly three params.

query.name: gapfill-true
query.note: gapfill=true is encoded as the string "true".

query.name: gapfill-false-omitted
query.note: gapfill=false must NOT appear in the query string at all (server default is false).

query.name: mode-passthrough
query.note: When an SDK exposes `mode`, an explicit mode reaches the query string (today the enum has one value, `delta`, but dropping it silently is a trap — B8).

query.name: member-param-passthrough
query.note: series?member=<key> selects one member's series (MemberSeriesResponse). The member key reaches the query verbatim; it is validated against member-keys.json before the query is built (no additional encoding).

query.name: groupby-member-passthrough
query.note: series?groupBy=member returns the dense per-member multi-series (MemberGroupSeriesResponse). `groupBy` reaches the query as the literal string "member" (its only value).

query.name: member-and-groupby-locally-exclusive
query.note: member and groupBy are mutually exclusive (the server returns 400 — see requests.json member-series-member-and-groupby-400). An SDK that exposes both must reject the combination client-side BEFORE issuing the request; the error carries the 'validation' taxonomy type (conformance/errors). A case with `expect.taxonomy` has no `query` — the contract is that encoding raises, not that a request is sent.

parse.name: empty-points
parse.note: Empty series (no activity, gapfill off) parses to zero points, not an error.

parse.name: bignum-point
parse.note: Delta is an arbitrary-precision decimal string that overflows i64 — never parsed to a native int.

parse.name: member-series-one-member
parse.note: A `MemberSeriesResponse` body (series?member=). Same point wire keys (t, v) as a plain series, plus a top-level `member`. `kind` selects the parsed type; cases without `kind` default to the plain SeriesResponse above.

parse.name: member-group-series-two-members
parse.note: A `MemberGroupSeriesResponse` body (series?groupBy=member): a `series` array of {member, points}. Two members x two points. There is no top-level `mode` on this shape (openapi.yaml MemberGroupSeriesResponse). Deltas stay arbitrary-precision decimal strings.
